title: Pax River facility for Lockheed-to-Bigelow transfer
summary: Eric Burles tells of Pax River facility for Lockheed-to-Bigelow transfer, about 2025 at Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland

tellings.quote: I was able to actually be on site and see the facility that would have been that facility that they were going to transfer from Loheed Martin to Bigalow Airspace.

tellings.difference: Michels relays it second hand, quoting Burlison as saying that if a craft were stored anywhere it would be at Pax River, without mentioning the Lockheed-to-Bigelow transfer.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Congressman Burlison's site visit to the Pax River facility linked to Bigelow as the place a craft would be kept.
